描述_ZN: Ruan Guangxian Entering the Hajj and Giving a Banquet, in the album Pingding the War in Annam, Qianlong, Qing dynasty, painted by an unknown artist, on paper, color, 55.6 cm long and 91.2 cm wide.　　The upper part of the painting is inscribed by the Qianlong emperor with the poem "Ruan Hui sent his nephew Ruan Guangxian to the court to give a banquet", and the inscription reads, "The imperial brush in mid-autumn of the Qianlong period." Inscriptions include "Guxi Tianzi's treasure", "Sanxitang Jingjian Seal", and "Yizi Sun". The year "Jiyou" is the 54th year of the Qianlong era (1789), when the Qianlong emperor was 79 years old.　　In the second half of the 18th century, war broke out in Annam (present-day Vietnam) due to regime change. The brothers Nguyen Van Ngoc and Nguyen Huy (later renamed Nguyen Quang Binh) of Qui Nhon Province led an army to overthrow the Le Dynasty and King Le Vicky left. In 1788, the mother and wife of the king of Annam asked the Qing court for help. In view of the fact that since 1666, when the Qing court crowned King Le Vicky as the king of Annam, the Le dynasty had paid tribute to the Qing court and was very obedient to the Qing court, the Qianlong Emperor decided to send troops to help Le and restore the rule of the Le dynasty in Annam. The Qianlong Emperor ordered Sun Shiyi, the governor of the two provinces, to lead the conquest and soon captured Xuanguang and Xinghua in Annam, and embraced Le Vicky to reassume the throne. However, the following year, when the Qing soldiers were celebrating the New Year festival, they were attacked by Ruan Hui's army, and the Qing soldiers responded hastily and lost their troops, and the city was regained. Although Nguyen Hue defeated the Qing army and destroyed the Le Dynasty, he knew that in order to stabilize the order and strengthen his rule, he had to be recognized and enthroned by the Qing Dynasty in order to gain legal status. In order to change the policy of the Qing court to "support Le and destroy Ruan", Ruan Hui kept seeking to improve the relationship with the Qing dynasty. Faced with Ruan Hui's persistent actions and the political situation in Annam, the Qianlong Emperor decided to change his policy towards Annam from Fuli to Ruan and crowned Ruan Hui as King of Annam.　　Qianlong emperor in order to commemorate the Qing army to Annan won several battles, while praising in the battle of Pingan South, Guangxi Governor Xu Shiheng, general Shang Wei Ping, Zhang Chaolong and other generals serve the court's heroic behavior, ordered the drawing of a "pacification of Annan war map" book (a total of 6). In addition to the battle maps showing the battles of the Shouchang River, the three different pillars of the right, the Shiqiu River, and the Fuliang River, there is also a picture depicting the arrival of Ruan Hui's nephew, Ruan Guangxian, at the summer resort in July 1789, where the Qianlong Emperor received Ruan Guangxian and his party at the grand opera house of the Qing Yin Pavilion, and ordered him to accompany the Mongolian princes and ministers of civil and military affairs to enjoy the opera. In the picture, the Qianlong Emperor is in full spirit, sitting on his knees, and in front of him are Ruan Guangxian and other ambassadors kneeling in a row wearing red robes. The composition of this painting is both realistic and vivid, depicting the strict hierarchical differences between the Emperor and his ministers, as well as the monarchical position of imperial power that the Emperor holds in the painting.
